---
title: "_mapmaking"
---

## Install & load packages

```{r}
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

source("../R/strip_lat_lon_fr_pt.R")
```

## Map with coordinates: World

```{r}
#| label: fetch-world-map
# Fetch world map data as an 'sf' object
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# Plot the map
ggplot(data = world) +
  geom_sf()
```

## Map three cities

```{r}
#| label: plot-basic-map
#| 
# A standard data frame with coordinates
cities_df <- data.frame(
  city = c("New York", "Paris", "Tokyo"),
  lon = c(-74.0060, 2.3522, 139.6503),
  lat = c(40.7128, 48.8566, 35.6762)
)

# Convert to an sf object (4326 is the standard GPS CRS, WGS84)
cities_sf <- st_as_sf(cities_df, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

# Layer the points over the base map
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "antiquewhite", color = "gray80") +
  geom_sf(data = cities_sf, color = "red", size = 3) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-100, 150), ylim = c(-20, 60)) # Zooming into an area
```

## Getting states

```{r}
#| label: get-states
us_states <- ne_states(country = "United States of America")
```

## Map my location

```{r}
#| label: fig-my-location
cities_df <- data.frame(
  city = c("State College"),
  lon = c(-77.84922),
  lat = c(40.79766)
)

# Convert to an sf object (4326 is the standard GPS CRS, WGS84)
cities_sf <- st_as_sf(cities_df, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = us_states, fill = "antiquewhite", color = "gray80") +
  geom_sf(data = cities_sf, color = "red", size = 1) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-80.5, -74.8), ylim = c(39.5, 42.5)) # Zooming into an area
```

## Import PA higher ed data

```{r}
#| label: import-higher-ed-data
pa_higher_ed <- readr::read_csv("../include/xlsx/PA_Higher_Education_Institutions_by_Sector_Current_Statewide_Education_20261015.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

summary(pa_higher_ed)
```

## Trim the data

```{r}
#| label: trim-higher-ed
pa_higher_ed_trimmed <- pa_higher_ed |>
  rename(lon = Longitude,
         lat = Latitude) |>
  select(Sector, College, Type, County, lon, lat) |>
  filter(!is.na(lat) &
         !is.na(lon))

```


```{r}
#| label: convert-higher-ed-data
# Convert to an sf object (4326 is the standard GPS CRS, WGS84)

pa_higher_ed_sf <-
  sf::st_as_sf(
    x = pa_higher_ed_trimmed,
    coords = c("lon", "lat"),
    crs = 4326
  )
```

## Map the data

```{r}
#| label: fig-pa-higher-ed
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = us_states, fill = "antiquewhite", color = "gray80") +
  geom_sf(data = pa_higher_ed_sf, aes(color = Sector), size = 1) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-80.5, -74.8), ylim = c(39.5, 42.5)) # Zooming into an area
```

## *ggmap*

Requires API key. Don't use for class.
